title: Greece – Furniture – Προμήθεια Ειδών Εξοπλισμού των Εγκαταστάσεων και των Καταλυμάτων στο Ζούμπερι Αττικής
description: Η Διεύθυνση Τεχνικών Υπηρεσιών(Τμήμα Γ' Μελέτης και Προμήθειας Εξοπλισμού του Υπουργείου Παιδείας, θρησκευμάτων και Αθλητισμού (Υ.ΠΑΙ.Θ.Α) προκηρύσσει Ηλεκτρονικό Διεθνή Ανοικτό Διαγωνισμός σε ευρώ, άνω των ορίων, με κριτήριο ανάθεσης την πλέον συμφέρουσα από οικονομική άποψη προσφορά βάσει τιμής, προμήθειας ειδών εξοπλισμού για την πράξη με τίτλο «Προμήθεια Ειδών Εξοπλισμού των Εγκαταστάσεων και των Καταλυμάτων στο Ζούμπερι Αττικής». Το φυσικό αντικείμενο του έργου είναι η προμήθεια και εγκατάσταση εξοπλισμού για τις εγκαταστάσεις και τα καταλύματα στο Ζούμπερι Αττικής, με στόχο την αναβάθμιση της λειτουργικότητας, της ασφάλειας και της άνεσης των χώρων. Πιο συγκεκριμένα, θα πραγματοποιηθεί η προμήθεια σύγχρονων και εργονομικών επίπλων για τα καταλύματα, όπως κρεβάτια, καρέκλες, τραπέζια. Οι επιλογές θα εξασφαλίσουν τόσο την άνεση των χρηστών όσο και τη μακροχρόνια ανθεκτικότητα των επίπλων. Επίσης, στην προμήθεια περιλαμβάνονται ο αναγκαίος ηλεκτρολογικός εξοπλισμός (π.χ. κουζίνα, φούρνος μικροκυμάτων, πλυντήρια, ψυγεία και κλιματιστικά) και ο ηλεκτρονικός εξοπλισμός, όπως τηλεοράσεις, συστήματα ήχου για την ενίσχυση της λειτουργικότητας των καταλυμάτων και τη βελτίωση των υπηρεσιών προς τους χρήστες. Τέλος, για την κάλυψη των αναγκών μετακίνησης εντός και εκτός των εγκαταστάσεων, θα προμηθευτεί ηλεκτρικό βαν, το οποίο θα χρησιμοποιείται για τη μεταφορά εξοπλισμού, προμηθευτικών αγαθών, καθώς και για την υποστήριξη των καθημερινών λειτουργιών του χώρου. Η επιλογή ηλεκτρικού οχήματος ενισχύει τη βιωσιμότητα του έργου, μειώνοντας το περιβαλλοντικό αποτύπωμα και τις εκπομπές καυσαερίων.

All Tenders must be delivered in closed envelopes bearing the mention “Supply of new Metro trainsets, 5 coaches each, including spare parts and consumables, equipment and tools for maintenance, repair and related services, up to a total budget of euro 45 (forty five) million, sales taxes and customs duties excluded” to the office at the address below on or before on 15 December 2026 at 13:00 (local time). Tenders will be opened immediately in the presence of Tenderers’ representatives who choose to attend.

title: PEO-SW: SOF Safety at Sea Assessment Event (AE)
description: PEO-SW: SOF Safety at Sea Assessment Event (AE) Submit NLT 14 December 2026 11:59 PM ET U.S. Persons Only Purpose SOFWERX, in collaboration with USSOCOM Program Executive Office SOF Warrior (PEO-SW) and Naval Special Warfare Command (NSWC), will host an Assessment Event (AE) to seek a prototype to support life raft capabilities in single Maritime SOF craft operations. Background/Synopsis Naval Special Warfare forces are seeking prototype solutions to enhance modernized, crew-sized emergency maritime survival and safety supplies for single maritime craft operations. Objective Seeking an industry partner to provide prototypes that can be taken to Operational Testing and Developmental Testing events by USSOCOM, with the ultimate solution to be selected for program procurement by FY29. Why You Should Participate USSOCOM seeks to enter into non-FAR or FAR-based agreements with Industry, Academic, and National Lab partners whose solutions are favorably evaluated by Program Executive Office SOF Warrior Subject Matter Experts (SMEs). As such, the follow-on Assessment Event (AE) is considered competitive, and solutions will be evaluated independently of one another primarily for technical merit. This serves dually as notification of the intent to research the feasibility of an agreement under 10 U.S. Code, Section 4022 and/or Section 4022(f), and as notice of pre-solicitation activities IAW FAR 5.101. Event Timeline Phase 1 - 13 November 2026 to 14 December 2026 Submissions to the Assessment Event (AE) Open: Interested respondents who could potentially provide solutions that meet the needs of USSOCOM are encouraged to submit their capability for USSOCOM review. To submit your technology for potential Phase 4 attendance, please review the assessment criteria and follow the submission instructions at the bottom of this webpage. Phase 2a - 02 December 2026 Q&A Telecon: Interested offerors may participate in a virtual Q&A session to better understand the PM's specific technology objectives. The telecon will take place on 02 December from 12:00-1:00 PM ET. RSVP at the bottom of this webpage. Phase 3 - 15 December 2026 to 22 December 2026 Downselect: USSOCOM will downselect those respondents/submissions they feel have the highest potential to satisfy their technology needs. Favorably evaluated submissions will receive an invitation to attend the AE on/around 23 December. Phase 4 - 12 January 2027 to 14 January 2027 Assessment Event (AE): During the AE, selected participants will be allotted a one-on-one session with the USSOCOM evaluation panel to pitch, demonstrate, and/or discuss their solutions. The forum will include a Q&A portion, and discussions may continue outside of the event. Solution brief presentation guidelines will be outlined in the event invitation, and solutions will be assessed according to the criteria in the link provided below. If the USSOCOM evaluation panel favorably evaluates a solution brief, negotiations for Phase 5 may immediately begin. This event will be held in person at SOFWERX. Phase 5 - Path Forward: Successfully negotiated awards may fall under any combination of these categories: Business to business research and development agreement as a sub-award through the SOFWERX Partnership Intermediary Agreement (PIA) (15 U.S. Code Section 3715) OTA for research or prototype projects (10 U.S. Code Sections 4021, 4022) An award under 10 U. S. Code, Section 4022 may result in the further award of a follow-on production agreement without additional competition based on successful prototype completion. The Government may make this follow-on production award based upon successful prototype criteria, which will be determined for each prototype project. Procurement for experimental purposes (10 U.S. Code Section 4023) Cooperative Research and Development Agreement (15 U.S. Code Section 3710a) Prizes for advanced technology achievements (10 U. S. Code Section 4025) and/or prize competitions (15 U.S. Code 3719) FAR-based procurement contract NOTE: Awardees may need to be compliant with NIST SP 800-171, Protecting Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) in Non-Federal Systems and Organizations How You Can Participate Government, Industry, Academia, National Labs, and Non-Traditional Attendees RSVP to the 02 December Virtual Q&A Telecon: Click Here to RSVP (NLT 01 December) Review Assessment Criteria: Click Here to Review Download the White Paper Template:Click Here to Review Download the Quad Chart Template: Click Here to Review Complete the Submission Form: Click Here to Submit(NLT 14 December) Questions? For event-related questions, please contact Olivia Larounis

The VA intends to award a MATOC for mechanical maintenance, repair, alteration, and repair of buildings and other real property belonging to this facility, with task orders ranging in value from $2,000 to $3,000,000. The maximum net value of all task orders and modifications, combined for all contractors issued under this MATOC shall not exceed $20 Million. The net aggregate value for the individualized contractor for all task orders and modifications issued against the MATOC shall not exceed $19 Million. The MATOC will include a five (5) year ordering period from date of award. The VA anticipates a minimum of two (2) IDIQ contract awards and shall reserve the right to make additional IDIQ awards. The primary purpose/work to be ordered under this contract is mechanical construction (NAICS 238220) but may include work incidental to the overall construction work, such as carpentry; asphalt and concrete paving; roofing; excavation; interior renovation; carpet, window, door installation; mechanical; electrical; plumbing; painting and stucco; demolition; masonry; fire protection; telecommunications; HVAC; and other construction-related work. As project requirements are defined, individual task order solicitations will be competitively issued to all selected MATOC contractors. The NAICS code for this procurement is 238220 with a size standard of $19.0 Million Dollars. The construction range for the seed project is between $1,000,000 and $2,000,000. Contractors will be required under the contract to have a minimum individual task order bonding capacity of $2,000,000 for the life of the contract. This acquisition shall be 100% set-aside for Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SBVOSB) concerns per the authority of 38 U.S.C. 8127 (Public Law 109-461). In accordance with VAAR 819.7003(b), at the time of submission of proposal, the offeror must represent that is a SDVOSB concern, a small business concern under the NAICS code assigned to the acquisition, and has a SBA SDVOSB Certification Veteran Small Business Certification (www.sba.gov). This Pre-Solicitation notice is NOT a request for proposals or submittals of any kind. The VA plans to issue the official solicitation 36C25227R0002 on or about 11/20/2026. title: Sanierung Götzisbodenweg
description:
Die Gemeinde Pratteln realisiert die Sanierung des Götzisbodenwegs. Vollständig erneuert werden der Strassenaufbau mitsamt Randabschlüssen, die Strassenentwässerung und die Beleuchtung. Auf der gesamten Länge wird eine neue Wasserleitung verlegt und Hausanschlüsse erneuert. Neue Leerrohre und Schächte für das Multimedianetz und die Beleuchtung sowie kleinere Arbeiten für die IWB-Gasleitung und das EBL-Elektrotrassee ergänzen die Werkleitungsarbeiten. Der Projektperimeter erstreckt sich von der Einmündung Giebenacherstrasse bis zum provisorischen Kehrplatz auf Höhe der Raststätte Pratteln Süd. Die Gesamtlänge des Sanierungsprojekts beträgt rund 300 m.

Die Vergabe der Bauarbeiten erfolgt vorbehaltlich der noch ausstehenden Zustimmung durch den Einwohnerrat.

Tato veřejná zakázka je zadávána s využitím metody stanovení požadavků na výkon a funkci (Design & Build), které jsou specifikovány v technických specifikacích dle Přílohy č. 1 zadávací dokumentace. title: ThAi.3002 - Tiefbauarbeiten für Deichrückverlegung und Flutmulde
description: 1. Deichrückverlegung Aicha (DRV): • Neubau eines zonierten Hochwasserschutzdeiches in Erdbauweise (Länge ca. 2,7 km, Höhe ca. 1,5 bis 6 m) bestehend aus Zone 1 (nicht bindiges, kalkhaltiges Deckenlagenmaterial, ca. 52.900 m³), Zone 2 (nicht bindiger Stützkörper, ca. 85.700 m³) und Zone 3 (bindige Deichbasis aus Eigenmaterial, ca. 53.600 m³). • Herstellung einer Deichinnendichtung in Deichachse bis ca.14,5 m Tiefe, nach Wahl des AN (Dichtwand oder Spundwand, Fläche der Deichinnendichtung ca. 21.600 m²). • Wegebauarbeiten zur Herstellung des asphaltierten Deichhinterwegs (Breite 3,5 m), des Deichkronenwegs als Schotterrasen (Breite 3m), Deichüberfahrten (5 Stück) sowie verschiedener Rampen und Anschlüsse an das vorhandene Wegenetz. • Begleitende Landschaftsbauarbeiten wie Oberboden-, Ansaat- und Mähearbeiten, inkl. Sodenumsetzung aus dem bestehenden Deich Aicha in die DRV (siehe auch Punkt 2). 2. Rückbau des bestehenden Deichs Aicha: • Rückbau des Stützkörpers des Bestanddeichs Süd über eine Länge von ca. 1,7 km inkl. Materialgewinnung für den Deichneubau (ca. 12.200 m ³ bindiges Material aus der Oberflächenabdichtung und ca. 30.600 m³ aus dem kiesigem Stützkörper). • Übertragen des Oberbodens auf die neue DRV, teilweise als Sode. • Rekultivierung der ehemalige Deichaufstandsfläche (ca. 18.400 m²) 3. Temporäre Querdeich: • Herstellung eines ca. 300 m langen Querdeichs aus Lieferkies (ca. 13.900 m³) mit landseitigem Dränfilter aus Schotter 5/56 zur Aufrechterhaltung des Hochwasserschutzes während der Bauzeit. 4. buyer: Transports publics de la région lausannoise sa
title: MP 2026.02.831 - Contrat-cadre pour l'acquisition de véhicules de service
description:
Les Transports publics de la région lausannoise SA (tl) exploitent un parc de véhicules de service utilisés pour des activités opérationnelles telles que la maintenance des infrastructures, la logistique ou encore le support aux interventions techniques. Une partie significative de ce parc arrive aujourd’hui en fin de vie, en raison de l’atteinte des seuils d’âge ou de kilométrage définis.


Dans ce contexte, les tl ont engagé une démarche globale de renouvellement visant à moderniser et rationaliser leur flotte de véhicules de service. Cette démarche s’inscrit également dans une volonté de transition énergétique, avec un passage progressif vers des motorisations entièrement électriques.


Le présent appel d’offres est lancé afin de sélectionner un fournisseur en mesure de répondre à ces besoins dans le cadre d’un contrat-cadre. Il porte sur l’acquisition de véhicules utilitaires légers électriques, avec des exigences élevées en matière de performance, de fiabilité et de service après-vente, afin de garantir la continuité des activités opérationnelles.

buyer: Transports publics de la région lausannoise sa
title: MP 2026.03.836 - Contrat-cadre pour la fourniture de mâts
description:
L’adjudicateur exploite plusieurs lignes de trolleybus avec une infrastructure de lignes de contact (LAC) dans l’agglomération lausannoise et effectue divers travaux de construction et de transformation de ces lignes.

Cet appel d’offres porte sur l’acquisition de mâts destinés à la LAC pour les différents projets de construction et/ou transformation de ces lignes (environ 1'000 mâts sur un horizon de 5 ans).

Le marché comprend principalement :

  • La fabrication et la fourniture de mâts en acier galvanisé destinés au support des équipements de ligne aérienne de contact ;
  • La fourniture de mâts de différents types, notamment des mâts encastrés et des mâts sur plaque de base ou spéciaux ;
  • Le dimensionnement des mâts, y compris les justificatifs statiques, sur la base des efforts, moments et exigences définis dans le cahier des charges technique ;
  • La réalisation des traitements de surface et protections (zingage, peinture, protections mécaniques et enterrées) conformément aux normes applicables ;
  • La livraison des fournitures sur site, y compris le conditionnement, le transport et le déchargement, selon les modalités définies contractuellement ;
  • La remise de l’ensemble de la documentation technique, incluant les plans d’exécution, justificatifs de calcul et certificats de conformité.

title: Leverich Helio Stewardship IRSC
description: 26/11/02 Update site questions on October 1, 2026. see attachments: B14 and A15. Sources Sought (SS) / Request for Information (RFI) This Sources Sought / Request for Information (RFI) is issued solely for market research and planning purposes. It does not constitute a solicitation or a promise to issue a solicitation in the future. The Government will not reimburse accompanying costs. Any answers or attachments provided are based upon the best information available at the time of the visit and are subject to change. 1. Background & Purpose USDA Forest Service seeks capability statements from qualified vendors able to conduct fuels reduction on steep and rugged terrain within Bozeman Municipal Watershed Project area for the anticipated Leverich Helio Stewardship IRSC. The purpose of this SS/RFI is to gather information on vendor capabilities, invite prospective vendors to an organized site visit on 10/01/2026, and to view the area before snow limits access. 2. Anticipated Scope of Work Cut and removal of approximately 290 CCF of Lodgepole pine sawtimber 2045 CCF of Douglas-fir and other Sawtimber on 151 acres. Whole-tree Helicopter yarding of included timber. Piling of slash at the landing area. Road Decommissioning of .59 miles of existing Temporary Road Use Permit (TRUP) roads post-hauling. 3. Place of Performance The Leverich Helio Stewardship IRSC project is located in the northern Gallatin Mountain Range, just south of Bozeman, MT. Helicopter units are located on the west side of FS Road #979, along Bozeman Creek and adjacent to City of Bozeman land. 4. Period of Performance Anticipated start date: Late Spring/Early Summer 2027. Period of performance is estimated to not exceed two operational seasons and is dependent on weather, access, and coordination. 5. Site Visit An organized site visit will occur on Thursday, October 1, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. MDT. Interested parties will meet at the Bozeman Ranger District located at 3710 Fallon St. Suite C. Bozeman, MT 59718. Interested parties should contact Nathan Motzko at nathan.motzko@usda.gov or 406-224-0323 by 12:00 p.m. MDT on September 30, 2026, if they intend to attend. 6. Requested Capability Statement Content Company information (UEI, address, email, POC, socio-economic status). Relevant experience, especially hazardous fuel reduction, helicopter yarding, steep slope timber operations. Safety program details and crew qualifications. Equipment lists and mobilization capabilities. Past performance references. 7. Response Instructions & Due Date Any information submitted by vendors to this this SS/RFI is voluntary. Responses should be submitted electronically to Jeanne Windle at norma.windle@usda.gov. All responses are due no later than October 15, 2026, at 4:00 p.m. MDT. 8. Points of Contact Direct all questions via email to Jeanne Windle, Contracting Officer at norma.windle@usda.gov.

Jedná se o osazení nových 30 ks nabíjecích stanic o výkonu 22kW (26 ks) a 2x75kW (4ks) na určených místech v areálu, osazení 1ks nabíjecí stanice elektrokol 2,3kW. Součástí zadání je kompletní SW řešení včetně popisu funkcí systému.

title: Muutosturvakoulutusten pienhankintarekisteri, uusi ilmoitus
description: Muutosturvakoulutusten pienhankintarekisteri, uusi ilmoitus Business Oulu -liikelaitos (jäljempänä myös "BusinessOulu", "Tilaaja" ja "Hankintayksikkö") pyytää tarjouksia Oulun seudun työllisyysalueella järjestettävistä muutosturvakoulutuksista (jäljempänä myös "muutosturva55+ -koulutus") tämän tarjouspyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Oulun seudun työllisyysalueeseen kuuluvat seuraavat kunnat Hailuoto, Ii, Kempele, Liminka, Lumijoki, Muhos, Oulu, Pudasjärvi, Tyrnävä, Utajärvi ja Vaala. Business Oulu -liikelaitoksen työllisyysjaosto on Oulun kaupungin organisaatioon kuuluva toimielin, joka vastaa työvoimapalvelujen järjestämisestä Oulun seudun työllisyysalueella. Hankinnalla perustetaan dynaamisen hankintajärjestelmän toimintamalliin pohjautuva pienhankintarekisteri, johon hyväksytään kaikki tarjouspyynnön soveltuvuusvaatimukset ja tarjouspyynnössä esitetyt muut kriteerit täyttävät tarjoajat. Muutosturvakoulutuksella tuetaan työstään tuotannollisella tai taloudellisella perusteella irtisanottujen 55 vuotta täyttäneiden henkilöiden nopeaa uudelleen työllistymistä parantamalla heidän ammatillista osaamistaan tai yrittäjävalmiuksiaan. Muutosturvakoulutuksia säädellään julkisesta työvoima- ja yrityspalvelusta annetun lain 5a luvussa (916/2012). Pienhankintarekisteristä voidaan hankkia palveluita suoraan rekisteriin hyväksytyltä toimijalta tai kilpailuttamalla nopeutetulla aikataululla joko rajoitetulla menettelyllä tai kaikilta rekisteriin hyväksytyiltä tarjoajilta Hankinnasta kiinnostuneita ehdokkaita pyydetään jättämään osallistumishakemus Tarjouspalvelu.fi-portaalissa tämän osallistumispyynnön ja sen liitteiden mukaisesti. Hankinnasta julkaistaan tämä uusi ilmoitus teknisen virheen vuoksi. Edellinen ilmoitus avattiin hankintailmoitus 11.3.2025 ja siihen hyväksymispäätöksen (§49/2025, toimitettu 16.4.2025) saaneiden tarjoajien ei tarvitse jättää uutta osallistumisilmoitusta,

title: CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT SERVICES, WHITEHORSE CADET TRAINING CENTRE WHITEHORSE
description: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE Construction Management Services, Whitehorse cadet training centre whitehorse, yukon (with security requirements) 1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at Whitehorse, Yukon. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). 2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES The objective of this contract is to recapitalize both vertical and horizontal infrastructure at the Whitehorse Cadet Training Centre (WCTC) through a multi-year program. The existing WCTC site includes a diverse portfolio of facilities comprising 39 buildings with a total floor area of approximately 5,000 m². These facilities include barracks with associated ablution areas, classrooms, a combined kitchen/dining/administration building, a large storage warehouse, and various workshops and auxiliary support structures. The recapitalization program will encompass the renovation of existing buildings, as well as the demolition and reconstruction of selected facilities, to modernize and enhance the overall functionality of the site. Project delivery will be undertaken using a Construction Management (CM) contract. The Government of Canada is committed to advancing reconciliation and fostering meaningful engagement with Indigenous Peoples. In support of these commitments, DND aims to create opportunities for Indigenous businesses and communities through meaningful subcontracting, employment, and training related to the proposed project. To align with these objectives, the successful proponents will be required to develop an Indigenous Benefits Plan (IBP) as part of the CM contract. The IBPs will outline proposed initiatives and opportunities for Indigenous participation, including subcontracting, employment, and training activities. It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. APN: APN_NPYKCM01 Approximate Estimate: $50M Anticipated Posting: Winter 2027 3. CONTRACT AWARD AND ANTICIPATED SECURITY REQUIREMENTS To be eligible for contract award, a proponent  will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS) 4. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors  that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN. 5. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a contractor has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and has submitted a proposal.   DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Note – Contractors  that do not submit a proposal  will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process. Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. 6. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Eric Ndayambaza Coordinator, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada Eric.Ndayambaza@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Email: +(1) 343-576-9347 7. Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations  or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: 13043.10 / 214-05 Holzbau, Instandsetzung & Erweiterung Betriebsgebäude Seepolizei und Schifffahrtskontrolle Oberrieden
description:
BKP 214-05 Construction en bois


Situation initiale

Le canton de Zurich réalise, sur le site d’Oberrieden, la réhabilitation et l’extension du bâtiment d’exploitation de la Police lacustre et du Contrôle de la navigation. La base existante fera l’objet d’une rénovation complète, d’une mise à niveau structurelle ainsi que d’une extension par la construction d’un nouveau bâtiment.

L’exploitation de la Police lacustre sera maintenue pendant la durée des travaux au moyen d’installations provisoires distinctes. L’objectif est de créer une base moderne, sûre et rénovée sur le plan énergétique, répondant durablement aux exigences opérationnelles.


Aperçu du projet

Le projet comprend l’ensemble des travaux de construction en bois du projet principal et se compose des éléments suivants :

  • Éléments préfabriqués de murs, de planchers et de toiture en ossature bois, à nervures et en caissons creux
  • Revêtements rapportés sur la structure massive existante ainsi que structure porteuse principale composée de poteaux et de poutres
  • Revêtements extérieurs et intérieurs, y compris les habillages de protection incendie, de protection acoustique et d’amélioration acoustique


Le site est situé sur la Seestrasse à Oberrieden (ZH). Les travaux seront exécutés en plusieurs étapes.

title: 13043.10 / 221-01 Fenster, Instandsetzung & Erweiterung Betriebsgebäude Seepolizei und Schifffahrtskontrolle Oberrieden

BKP 221-01 Fenêtres


Situation initiale

Le canton de Zurich réalise, sur le site d’Oberrieden, la réhabilitation et l’extension du bâtiment d’exploitation de la Police lacustre et du Contrôle de la navigation. La base existante fera l’objet d’une rénovation complète, d’une mise à niveau structurelle ainsi que d’une extension par la construction d’un nouveau bâtiment.

Aperçu du projet

Le projet comprend l’ensemble des fenêtres de l’enveloppe du bâtiment du projet principal et se compose des éléments suivants :

  • Fourniture et montage de nouvelles fenêtres bois-métal à triple vitrage isolant pour le bâtiment existant et l’extension
  • Vitrages fixes, fenêtres oscillo-battantes, basculantes et guichets de service, répartis en douze types de fenêtres conformément aux plans de types

Le site est situé sur la Seestrasse à Oberrieden (ZH). Les travaux seront exécutés en plusieurs étapes.

title: 13043.10 / 213-01 Stahlbau, Instandsetzung & Erweiterung Betriebsgebäude Seepolizei und Schifffahrtskontrolle Oberrieden
description:
BKP 213-01 Construction métallique


Situation initiale

Le canton de Zurich réalise, sur le site d’Oberrieden, la réhabilitation et l’extension du bâtiment d’exploitation de la Police lacustre et du Contrôle de la navigation. La base existante fera l’objet d’une rénovation complète, d’une mise à niveau structurelle ainsi que d’une extension par la construction d’un nouveau bâtiment.

L’exploitation de la Police lacustre sera maintenue pendant la durée des travaux au moyen d’installations provisoires distinctes. L’objectif est de créer une base moderne, sûre et rénovée sur le plan énergétique, répondant durablement aux exigences opérationnelles.


Aperçu du projet

Le projet comprend les travaux de construction métallique du projet principal et se compose des éléments suivants :

  • Fabrication, protection de surface et montage du grillage porteur destiné à l’héliport à partir de nouveaux profilés en acier
  • Remise en état et transformation de poutres en acier de réemploi destinées aux poutres secondaires à l’intérieur du bâtiment, en partie sous forme de poutres alvéolaires
  • Éléments métalliques complémentaires tels que cornières d’appui pour la construction en bois, cages d’ancrage, boulons d’ancrage et appuis antivibratiles


Le site est situé sur la Seestrasse à Oberrieden (ZH). Les travaux seront exécutés en plusieurs étapes.

title: SP Steigerhubel, Steigerhubelstrasse 55b, Rasenplätze, BKP 496.5 Landschaftsarchitektur
description:
Der Auftrag umfasst die Planung der folgenden beiden Aufgaben:


Zur weiteren Kapazitätserhöhung soll neben der Sanierung des Trainingsfelds nach DIN18035, das Hauptfeld von einem Naturrasen in einen Kunstrasen umgebaut werden. Damit sollen die Nutzungs-stunden erhöht werden und den Platz sowie das Garderobengebäude auch für andere Vereine zugänglich gemacht werden. Die beiden Sportplätze werden zurzeit ausschliesslich vom SC Holligen 94 genutzt.


Für die Nutzung des Kunstrasens und des Naturrasens soll ein geeignetes Bewässerungssystem ge-funden werden. Die Beleuchtung aus dem Jahre 2016 ist in einem guten Zustand. Die umliegende Umgebung soll jedoch auf Lichtverschmutzung infolge Streulichtes überprüft werden. Bei Bedarf sind die Leuchtmittel auszutauschen oder die bestehende Beleuchtung zu ersetzten.


Die vorhandene Ausstattung wie Ballfang und Tore sollen, wenn möglich weiterverwendet und mit Tordepots 3-in-1-System mit ebenerdigen Zugängen sowie einer Spielanzeige nach üblichem Standard ergänzt werden. Falls möglich, ist entlang des Spielfeldes ein Zuschauerbereich mit einzuplanen, welcher mit einer umlaufenden Spielfeldabschrankung vom Spielfeld abzugrenzen ist. Die Zweiradparkierung sowie die Logistik des Personenverkehrs vor Ort wurden bereits im Rahmen der Garderobenerweiterung geprüft. Wir gehen von keinen weiteren Massnahmen aus. Dies ist mit der Verkehrsplanung abzusprechen.

description: THIS IS A SOURCES SOUGHT. The FAA is seeking interest in a Grounds Maintenance Service contract at Albuquerque ARTCC (ZAB), 8000 Louisiana Blvd. NE, Albuquerque, NM 87109. The SOW with photos is attached to this announcement. If interested please email Carey.Gonzalez@FAA.gov with a CC of Josh.Haker@FAA.gov. The email subject must include "ZAB Grounds Maintenance-Interested Vendor" along with your company's capability statement and the following: Company Name: Company POC: Company Phone: Company Email: Company UEI: Weed control and groundskeeping services in Albuquerque, NM typically involve a variety of tasks aimed at maintaining the health, appearance, and functionality of outdoor spaces, whether they are residential, commercial, or public areas. These services can include: Weed Control: This involves the removal and prevention of unwanted plants and weeds that can affect the health of desired plants and the aesthetics of the landscape. Services may include manual removal, chemical treatments, and organic solutions tailored to the specific needs of the area. Lawn Care: Regular mowing, edging, aeration, fertilization, and reseeding are part of lawn care services to ensure a lush and healthy lawn. Providers often focus on using practices suitable for Albuquerque�s climate, including drought-resistant strategies. Landscaping: Design and maintenance of gardens and outdoor spaces, including planting flowers, shrubs, and trees that are suitable for the local climate. Landscaping might also include hardscaping elements such as patios, walkways, and irrigation systems. Tree and Shrub Care: Trimming, pruning, and health assessments for trees and shrubs are important to prevent disease, encourage growth, and maintain safety. Irrigation Systems: Installation and maintenance of irrigation systems to ensure efficient water use, crucial in Albuquerque�s arid environment. This might include drip systems or smart irrigation technologies. Seasonal Cleanups: Removal of leaves, debris, and other waste, particularly during fall and spring, to maintain a neat appearance and prevent plant disease. Pest Control: Management of pests that can damage plants and lawns, using environmentally friendly methods where possible. Groundskeeping for Commercial Properties: Enhanced services that may include parking lot maintenance, exterior cleaning, and snow removal in winter months. Providers in Albuquerque may offer customized plans based on the unique requirements of the property and the preferences of the property owner. Additionally, they typically emphasize sustainable practices to cope with the region's water scarcity and environmental concerns.

description: SOLICITATION NOTICE MULTIPLE-AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (MACC) FOR GENERAL CONSTRUCTION SERVICES Solicitation No. 75N99027R00002 The Department of Health and Human Services (HHS), National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of Acquisition and Logistics Management (OALM), Construction, A&E, Facilities and Leasing Office (CAFLO), anticipates issuing a Request for Proposals (RFP) for a Multiple-Award Construction Contract (MACC) to support the ongoing construction, alteration, repair, and maintenance requirements of the NIH Office of Research Facilities (ORF). The resulting contracts will be multiple-award Indefinite-Delivery, Indefinite-Quantity (IDIQ) construction contracts. Work will be authorized through individually issued task orders. This acquisition is anticipated to be conducted using competitive negotiated procedures under FAR Part 15. The Government intends to award multiple IDIQ construction contracts under FAR Subpart 16.5. Individual task orders will generally be awarded on a firm-fixed-price basis. The anticipated aggregate ceiling is $3 billion over an eight-year ordering period. Individual construction requirements will be competed through task orders among eligible MACC awardees in accordance with the ordering procedures established in the resulting contracts. The solicitation and resulting contracts will include procedures for adding and removing awardees during that period (on/off ramp). The initial seed-project scope estimated construction magnitude, applicable evaluation factors, and proposal submission requirements will be provided in the solicitation. SCOPE OF WORK Work under the MACC will primarily consist of general construction and may include, but is not limited to, maintenance, repair, painting, alterations, architectural work, mechanical systems, electrical systems, plumbing, heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC), civil work, earthwork, fencing, structural work, steel fabrication and welding, roofing, building renovations, demolition, new building construction, sustainable construction, design-bid-build, and design-build projects. Individual task orders may include one or more construction disciplines and will vary in size, scope, and complexity. All work will be performed in accordance with the requirements, specifications, drawings, and other documents applicable to each individual task order. LOCATIONS OF WORK The National Institutes of Health (NIH), Office of Research Facilities (ORF) is the steward of NIH facilities and is responsible for the planning, design, construction, acquisition, maintenance and operation of NIH owned facilities, which include campuses in: � Bethesda, Maryland, � Frederick, Maryland, � Poolesville, Maryland, � Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, � The Rocky Mountain Laboratories (RML) in Hamilton, Montana. NAICS CODE AND SMALL BUSINESS SIZE STANDARD The North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) code for this acquisition is 236220, Commercial and Institutional Building Construction. PSC Code: Y1JZ The corresponding small business size standard is $45 million. The NAICS code and small business size standard applicable to the initial seed project is also anticipated to be NAICS 236220 and $45 million, respectively. NIH anticipates awarding up to twenty (20) IDIQ contracts, consisting of: Approximately four (4) unrestricted/full-and-open awards; and Approximately sixteen (16) awards under small business reserves. The small business reserves are anticipated to include eligible concerns in the following categories: Historically Underutilized Business Zone (HUBZone) Small Business; Women-Owned Small Business (WOSB); Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB); and Participants in the SBA 8(a) Business Development Program. The solicitation will identify the anticipated distribution of the sixteen (16) reserve awards among the applicable small business and socioeconomic categories and will establish the eligibility requirements applicable to each reserve. NIH anticipates approximately four (4) awards in each socioeconomic reserve. Offerors must meet all applicable SBA eligibility requirements for the category under which they submit an offer. BONDING CAPACITY Offerors competing for an unrestricted/full-and-open award shall provide evidence from their surety demonstrating, at a minimum, bonding capacity of: $100 million for a single project; and $300 million aggregate bonding capacity. Offerors competing for an award under a small business reserve shall provide evidence from their surety demonstrating, at a minimum, bonding capacity of: $3 million for a single project; and $10 million aggregate bonding capacity. The solicitation will establish the specific documentation required to demonstrate bonding capacity. Performance and payment bond requirements applicable to individual construction task orders will be established in accordance with the solicitation, resulting contracts, applicable law and regulation, and the requirements of each task order. SMALL BUSINESS ELIGIBILITY AND JOINT VENTURES Offerors seeking an award under a small business reserve must satisfy all applicable SBA eligibility requirements for the applicable reserve category and NAICS code. The solicitation will identify any documentation required to establish an offeror's eligibility for the applicable small business or socioeconomic category. Small business concerns intending to submit an offer as a joint venture must comply with all applicable SBA joint venture requirements, including applicable requirements governing SBA-approved Mentor-Prot�g� relationships. Prospective offerors should consult current SBA regulations and guidance concerning joint ventures and the SBA Mentor-Prot�g� Program at www.sba.gov. CONTRACT CEILING AND ORDERING PERIOD The aggregate maximum value of all contracts and task orders awarded under the MACC will not exceed $3,000,000,000.00 over the entire ordering period. The $3 billion ceiling applies collectively to all MACC contracts and is not a per-contractor ceiling. The anticipated ordering period will consist of one eight-year ordering period. There is no anticipated annual or individual-contractor ceiling other than limitations established by the terms of the resulting contracts and individual task orders. MACC holders will remain eligible to compete for task orders, subject to the terms and conditions of their contracts, until expiration of the ordering period or exhaustion of the aggregate MACC ceiling, whichever occurs first. TASK ORDERS All work under the MACC will be authorized through individual task orders. Individual task orders will generally be awarded on a firm-fixed-price basis and will be separately priced. Each task order will establish the applicable scope of work, specifications and drawings, period of performance, applicable wage determination, bonding requirements, and other project-specific requirements. Task orders may be competed among all eligible MACC holders or restricted to eligible small business MACC holders in accordance with the ordering procedures established in the solicitation and resulting contracts. The anticipated maximum value of an individual task order is $800 million. Eligibility to compete for individual task orders may be subject to project-specific requirements, including required bonding capacity. title: Landquart Extension de l'atelier pour véhicules ferroviaires thermiques et appareillage de commutation intérieure
description:
Dans l’atelier destiné aux véhicules thermiques, quatre voies équipées de fosses seront prolongées jusqu’à une longueur utile de 20 m grâce à la construction et à l’agrandissement du hall. En outre, des surfaces de remplacement seront aménagées pour le stockage du matériel ainsi que pour des locaux de bureaux. Dans le faisceau de voies situé devant les halls de l’atelier, les voies du groupe D seront renouvelées ou adaptées en position afin de correspondre à la géométrie des nouvelles entrées des halls. Le nouveau sous-sol à construire accueillera le poste de commutation intérieur destiné à la ligne de contact.

Le sous-sol sera réalisé en construction massive et mesurera environ 27,2 m sur 24,8 m. Dans le prolongement du hall existant, un nouveau hall d’environ 28,4 m sur 14,4 m (hall Ouest) sera construit en structure métallique (portiques à deux articulations avec une trame de poteaux de 6 m). Ce hall disposera d’un demi-niveau enterré réalisé en construction massive. L’extension de l’atelier, hall Est (17,7 m sur 13,4 m), sera partiellement excavée et réalisée sous la forme d’une construction métallique à un seul niveau.

Par ailleurs, un bâtiment intermédiaire de deux étages (15,7 m sur 8,2 m) sera construit en construction massive ; il sera également partiellement enterré.

Les travaux de construction et d’extension seront réalisés en parallèle de l’exploitation de l’atelier. Pendant toute la durée des travaux, l’utilisation de deux voies dans l’atelier devra être garantie.

title: Installation de répéteurs intérieurs et pour tunnels
description:
Par le présent appel d’offres, la Police cantonale bernoise souhaite acquérir des systèmes de répéteurs intérieurs et de tunnel répondant aux exigences de qualité et de performance opérationnelle définies dans le cahier des charges technique. Il s’agit de trois types différents d’installations de répéteurs internes et de tunnel (POLYCOM, téléphonie mobile et GNSS). Outre les installations de répéteurs intérieurs et de tunnels proprement dites, leur maintenance et leur réparation font également l’objet du marché. De plus, le prestataire doit effectuer les déclarations nécessaires auprès des opérateurs de téléphonie mobile.

 

Le contrat-cadre prévu doit permettre non seulement au mandant (Police cantonale bernoise), mais aussi à l’Office des ponts et chaussées du canton de Berne ainsi qu’aux autorités et organisations chargées du sauvetage et de la sécurité (AOSS), de commander des installations de répéteurs intérieurs et pour tunnels. Les commandes elles-mêmes ne sont donc pas passées par le mandant, mais de manière autonome par l’Office des ponts et chaussées du canton de Berne ainsi que par les AOSS.

title: Köniz, Umgestaltung Haltestellen Mösliweg, Belagsersatz Landorfstrasse
description:
Strassenbau- und Werkleitungsarbeiten

Die Gemeinde Köniz plant, die Bushaltestelle Mösliweg gemäss dem Behindertengleichstellungsgesetz hindernisfrei umzugestalten. Im gesamten Projektperimeter ist nun ein Belagsersatz mit lärmminderndem Belag vorgesehen. Vor und nach den Haltestellen wird der Deckbelag ersetzt. Dazwischen wird der kpmüplette Belag ersetzt. Auch die Einmündung des Mösliwegs wird bis zum Horizontalversatz erneuert.

Die Werkleitungen werden dort angepasst, wo dies aufgrund der neuen Strassenperimeter erforderlich ist. Betroffen sind insbesondere die Strassenentwässerung sowie je eine Leitung der öffentlichen Beleuchtung und von Sunrise. Zudem müssen zwei Kandelaber verschoben werden.

Die Bushaltestelle in Fahrtrichtung Niederwangen wird mit einer Busbetonplatte erstellt, wo der Deckbelag darüber eingebaut wird. Bei der Bushaltestelle in Fahrtrichtung Köniz Bahnhof wird eine zwei Schichtige Busbetonplatte erstellt.


Die Gemeinde Köniz hat zum Ziel, die direkten Treibhausgasemissionen auf Baustellen zu minimieren. Das heisst, dass so wenig mit Verbrennungsmotoren betriebene Maschinen, Fahrzeuge und Werkzeuge wie möglich eingesetzt werden sollen. Dies betrifft die Arbeit vor Ort (Baumaschinen und Werkzeuge) und die Baustellenlogistik inklusive der Personaltransporte. Nebst der Minimierung der direkten Treibhausgasemissionen führt die Elektrifizierung zu einer Reduktion der Lärm- und einer Eliminierung der Abgasemissionen.

description: Zadavatel zve dodavatele ke konzultaci podle § 33 zákona č. 134/2016 Sb., o zadávání veřejných zakázek , aby připravil zadávací podmínky budoucí veřejné zakázky na zajištění archivace své dokumentace. Cílem konzultace je zejména: • zjistit nabídku komerčních archivních a skladových prostor na území České republiky a služeb s nimi spojených, • ověřit, zda a za jakých podmínek jsou dodavatelé schopni garantovat zadavatelem požadovaný přístup ke spisům (digitální kopie v řádu hodin, fyzický originál v řádu dnů), • zjistit možnosti a cenu digitalizace dokumentace jako alternativy či doplňku fyzické archivace, • zmapovat aktuální cenovou hladinu pro stanovení předpokládané hodnoty veřejné zakázky (§ 16 ZZVZ). Konzultace není zadávacím řízením. Účast v ní ani neúčast nezakládá žádné právo ani povinnost dodavatele či zadavatele, sdělené ceny jsou orientační a nezávazné. Zadavatel vede konzultaci tak, aby nedošlo k narušení hospodářské soutěže a ke zvýhodnění žádného dodavatele.

description: De aanbesteding moet leiden tot een overeenkomst met een bank die voldoende expertise heeft om de universiteit te faciliteren met betrekking tot het huidige en toekomstige betalingsverkeer. Aan u wordt gevraagd een offerte uit te brengen voor het volgende: 1. Verzorgen van het betalingsverkeer voor de Universiteit Leiden, waarvoor onder meer een systeem voor elektronisch bankieren ter beschikking wordt gesteld, waarin de bankrekeningen van de eenheden van de universiteit en de gelieerde stichtingen worden ondergebracht binnen één complex waarin ofwel een dagelijkse saldoregulatie ofwel op andere wijze een zero balance structuur mogelijk is en rentecompensatie kan plaatsvinden althans ten aanzien van universitaire rekeningen. 2. Een voorstel om de handlingskosten van de kasstromen binnen de universiteit zoveel mogelijk, op een gebruikersvriendelijke wijze, te verlagen door o.a. een vermindering van het aantal bankrekeningen en een optimalisatie van het overig betalingsverkeer (m.n. ontvangsten voor diverse diensten). 3. overige diensten die de bank kan leveren om de universiteit te ondersteunen in het bereiken van hieraan verwante doelstellingen en bij het behouden van een financiële stabiele positie. Daarbij dient de bank de universiteit te wijzen op eventuele geïdentificeerde risico's in de bedrijfsvoering. Essentieel is dat de bank is aangehaakt op de procedure met betrekking tot schatkistbankieren. Verder moet de bank internationaal (wereld) betalingsverkeer kunnen faciliteren. Daarnaast is het belangrijk dat de bank gedurende de overeenkomst in staat is (proactief) op nieuwe ontwikkelingen te reageren, deze actief aan de Universiteit Leiden voor te stellen en deze te implementeren.

title: TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: DC Recruiter
description: DC Recruiter: Broad-Spectrum Immune Enhancer from scientists at Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a differentiated approach to multi-pathogen infection prevention by using a self-assembling peptide nanofiber to recruit and activate dendritic cells (DCs), the immune system�s natural sentinels. Unlike pathogen-specific vaccines or therapeutics, it is designed to help trigger an early immune response regardless of the infecting agent. Its needle-free, spray-friendly concept adds practicality. The Challenge: DC Recruiter addresses a persistent and highly consequential gap in infection management: the need for a rapid, broadly effective way to stimulate immune defense before the specific pathogen is known. In many exposure scenarios, the body encounters a threat before clinicians can identify the cause, and that delay can reduce the effectiveness of conventional interventions. Current vaccines, antibiotics and antivirals are generally designed to act against a known target, which limits their usefulness when exposure is unexpected, diagnosis is delayed or the pathogen is unfamiliar. That limitation creates a clear unmet need for a fast-acting, broad-spectrum approach that can be deployed early, with minimal complexity, and in settings where rapid response matters most, including outbreak situations, field environments and other high-risk conditions. Problems Solved: DC Recruiter solves this problem by using a specific peptide selected to bind to dendritic cells. By leveraging a self-assembling peptide nanofiber platform, the technology is designed to help �wake up� immune surveillance early, before infection can progress unchecked. Rather than relying on a treatment matched to one virus or bacterium, it creates the potential for broad-spectrum immune support across many different infectious threats. Its ability to provide broad-spectrum immune support makes it especially compelling for situations where time is critical and conventional options may be too specific, too slow or too late to provide immediate protection. The needle-free, spray-friendly concept also adds practical value by supporting easier administration and broader accessibility, strengthening its fit for real-world use cases that demand rapid, flexible deployment. Key Advantages: Helps the body respond faster after exposure to an infection Works in a broad, pathogen-agnostic way rather than against just one germ Targets dendritic cells, which help alert and activate the immune system May be useful when the exact cause of infection is not yet known Could be helpful in outbreak, emergency, or high-risk settings Has the potential to be easier to use because it is designed as a needle-free spray Market Applications: Infectious Disease Prevention (early-response immune support, broad-spectrum protection) Outbreak Response and Public Health (rapid deployment, exposure mitigation) Defense and National Security (force protection, biological threat preparedness) Consumer Health and Wellness (easy-to-use immune support, potential spray format) Pharmaceuticals and Biotech (next-generation immunomodulation, platform development) Emergency Preparedness (first-response tools, high-risk exposure settings) Development Status: TRL 3 US Patent pending LA-UR-26-24915 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. TECHNOLOGY LICENSING OPPORTUNITY: Bacterial Lipid Nanodiscs Platform
description: The Bacterial Lipid Nanodiscs Platform developed by Los Alamos National Laboratory provides a new way to study entire bacterial membranes in a controlled, nanoscale format derived directly from native lipid extracts. Researchers gain access to membrane components that typically remain difficult to isolate, stabilize or analyze, enabling more accurate evaluation of immunogenic lipids and membrane?associated targets. The platform offers a safer alternative to handling live high?risk pathogens while preserving the biological context that drives meaningful insights for vaccine design and antimicrobial discovery such as therapeutic antibodies to conserved lipids on bacterial membranes. How it Works The Bacterial Lipid Nanodiscs Platform creates uniform nanoscale discs from total lipid extracts harvested from bacterial membranes. Membrane scaffold protein MSP1D1 encases the lipid mixture and forms a stable disc roughly 10 nanometers wide. The resulting particles retain the full complement of native bacterial lipids, arranged in a membrane?like environment that supports realistic biological interactions without requiring synthetic lipids or live cells. Technical Description The method adapts established nanodisc assembly techniques to incorporate entire bacterial lipid extracts rather than defined synthetic lipid mixtures. Total lipids from a pathogen are solubilized, combined with MSP1D1 and dialyzed under controlled conditions to allow the scaffold protein to form a discoidal structure around the heterogeneous lipid population. The process yields nanoparticles that represent the membrane environment of the source organism, including amphiphilic molecules that typically resist purification or structural study when isolated from their native context. The approach was demonstrated using Yersinia pestis, chosen to illustrate how membrane characterization can proceed without the hazards associated with live Tier 1 pathogens. The method captures lipopolysaccharides (LPS) and diverse immunogenic lipids in an arrangement that mirrors their natural organization. Researchers can evaluate binding interactions, immune?stimulating properties and potential antigenic targets in a stable platform that avoids the limitations of outer membrane vesicle purification. Furthermore, using this platform we have identified antibodies specific to E. coli LPS and Y. pestis membrane lipids. These antibodies are independently licensable. Advantages � Provides membrane?like structures using native bacterial lipids � Avoids the safety challenges of handling live pathogens � Offers a broader and more realistic lipid environment than synthetic nanodiscs � Enables improved assessment of membrane antigens and immune responses � Supports analysis of diverse bacterial species using a unified workflow � Creates consistent nanoscale particles suitable for research and development settings Market Applications � Life Sciences Research (membrane biology, immunology) � Vaccine Development (bacterial antigen discovery) � Drug Discovery (membrane?associated targets) � Diagnostics (lipid biomarker exploration) � Biodefense Research (safe pathogen characterization) Development Status: TRL 3 U.S. Patent pending LA-UR-26-24920 LANL Tech Partnerships: Unlock the Innovative Potential Los Alamos National Laboratory offers a wide range of cutting-edge technologies and capabilities that may provide your company with a competitive edge in the market and unlock the innovative potential that can enhance, refine, and revolutionize your products. description: Provincie Limburg wil voor het technisch onderhoud, en de hieraan verbonden herstellingen, van de HVAC-installaties van de gebouwen van het provinciebestuur Limburg overgaan tot het opstellen van een raamovereenkomst. De raamovereenkomst wordt afgesloten voor de duur van 4 jaar. Deze raamovereenkomst heeft als doel te voorzien in: Deel 1: Wettelijk verplicht onderhoud - uitgevoerd door het eigen personeel van de opdrachtnemer (met de vereiste erkenningen) of erkende keuringsorganismes. - een jaarlijks nazicht van de stooktoestellen op stookolie en op gasvormige brandstoffen. - voor de koeltoestellen zal de dienstverlener ervoor zorgen dat de verplichtingen inzake onderhoud en nazicht worden nageleefd. - de dienstverlener staat in voor een dichtheidsmeting van de gasleidingen. Deel 2: Preventief onderhoud - bijkomend onderhoud bovenop de wettelijke vereisten, dat op regelmatige tijdstippen of op basis van de bedrijfsuren dient te gebeuren met als doel: - het bevorderen van de levensduur van de installaties; - het voorkomen van gevaarlijke toestanden; - het voorkomen van storingen en defecten; - het energieverbruik zo laag mogelijk te houden. Deel 3: Correctief onderhoud - onderhoud dat uitgevoerd wordt wanneer defecten zich voordoen: - storingen en defecten herstellen binnen de overeengekomen tijd; - de prijs voor de wisselstukken wordt bepaald op basis van een verhogingspercentage; Deel 4: Deelopdrachten - uitvoeren van werken in het kader van afbraak, vernieuwing en/of uitbreiding van technische installaties: - per deelopdracht wordt een afzonderlijk dienstbevel gegeven, waarbij aard en omvang van de werken, aanvangsdatum en uitvoeringstermijn worden opgegeven. Een eigen pv van vaststelling voor aanvaarding van de werken van de deelopdracht (deel-oplevering) zal worden opgemaakt, conform de bepalingen van dit bestek; - op basis van een prijs per uur voor de werkuren; - de prijs voor de nodige materialen wordt bepaald op basis van een verhogingspercentage; - er kan geen minimum aantal werkuren noch een minimum bedrag aan deelopdrachten bepaald worden. Deel 5: Wisselstukken op basis van een verhogingspercentage - het bedrag dat jaarlijks wordt voorzien voor de nodige wisselstukken (preventief onderhoud, correctief onderhoud en deelopdrachten) wordt vastgelegd op € 100 000 exclusief btw. De combinatie van deze interventies heeft als doel: - het bewerkstelligen van de bedrijfszekerheid; - het garanderen van een veilige werking; - Het voorkomen van gevaarlijke situaties; - Het bevorderen van de levensduur van de technische installaties, d.w.z. er voor zorgen dat de installaties, gezien vanuit economische en/of technische overwegingen, zo lang mogelijk meegaan; - Het materiaal behoeden voor beschadiging; - Het voorkomen van storingen en defecten; - Het herstellen van defecten; - Het energieverbruik te minimaliseren; - Plaatsen en in dienst stellen van bijkomende HVAC-installaties via deelopdrachten.

description: 1. Postępowanie prowadzone jest zgodnie z przepisami ustawy z dnia 11 września 2019 r. Prawo zamówień publicznych (Dz.U. z 2026 r. poz.793) zwana dalej ustawą Pzp Zamawiający udziela zamówienia w częściach, z których każda stanowi przedmiot odrębnego postępowania. 2. Zamawiający udziela zamówienia w częściach, z których każda stanowi przedmiot odrębnego postępowania o udzielenie zamówienia, zgodnie z art. 91 ust. 1 ustawy Pzp. Postępowanie prowadzone jest w celu zawarcia umowy ramowej w trybie przetargu nieograniczonego, na podstawie art. 311 ust. 1 pkt 1 w związku z art. 132 ustawy Pzp. Zamawiający zamierza zawrzeć umowę ramową z jednym Wykonawcą. Możliwość zawarcia umowy ramowej z jednym Wykonawcą wynika z art. 313 ust. 1 ustawy Pzp, który dopuszcza zawarcie umowy ramowej z jednym Wykonawcą. 3. [pkt 3 dotyczy wszystkich części zamówienia] Zamawiający przewiduje możliwość jednokrotnego wznowienia zamówienia na okres kolejnych 24 miesięcy, do wysokości wynagrodzenia. Wznowienie rozpoczyna się w dniu następującym po dniu upływu podstawowego okresu obowiązywania Umowy. Wznowienie polega na realizacji tego samego świadczenia (o tożsamym zakresie rzeczowym) na tych samych określonych w Umowie warunkach (nie wymaga zawarcia aneksu do Umowy). Wartość wznowienia jednokrotnego „odgórnie jest narzucona", jako tożsama z wartością zamówienia podstawowego i jest obliczana na podstawie wskazanych cen jednostkowych. Do wznowionego zamówienia mają zastosowanie wszystkie postanowienia Projektowanych postanowień mowy. Przedmiotem zamówienia jest: dostawa fabrycznie nowych części zamiennych i materiałów eksploatacyjnych do pojazdów ciężarowych, autobusów i akumulatorów z podziałem na 3 (trzy) części zamówienia. Część I – dostawa akumulatorów do pojazdów osobowych, dostawczych, mikrobusów, ciężarowych i autobusów. Część II – dostawa części i materiałów eksploatacyjnych do pojazdów ciężarowych, Część III – dostawa części i materiałów eksploatacyjnych do autobusów. Szczegółowy opis przedmiotu zamówienia określają załączniki nr 1, 1.1 - 1.3. oraz 4.1. – 4.2. do SWZ tj.: Formularz ofertowy wraz ze Specyfikacją asortymentowo - cenową oraz Projektowane postanowienia umowy. Orientacyjny zakres wraz z ilościami przedmiotu zamówienia określono w załączniku nr 1.1. – 1.3. treści SWZ, sporządzony na bazie przewidywanych, orientacyjnych potrzeb (obsługowo - naprawczych) na lata 2027, 2028 oraz 2029. Zamawiający nie dysponuje wiedzą na temat dokładnych ilości, rodzaju oraz terminu realizacji swoich potrzeb związanych z obsługą techniczną, konserwacją i naprawami pojazdów pozostających w jego dyspozycji, jakie w przyszłości mają być zaspokojone. Rzeczywiste zapotrzebowanie Zamawiającego będzie uzależnione w szczególności od liczby i rodzaju eksploatowanych pojazdów, ich stanu technicznego, intensywności eksploatacji, przebiegu, stopnia zużycia poszczególnych podzespołów i elementów, a także od zakresu i częstotliwości wykonywanych okresowych przeglądów technicznych, w tym przeglądów rocznych, planowych wymian części i materiałów eksploatacyjnych, jak również od rodzaju, zakresu i częstotliwości występujących awarii i usterek oraz konieczności przeprowadzania napraw pojazdów. Zapotrzebowanie będzie obejmowało części i materiały eksploatacyjne niezbędne zarówno do realizacji planowych czynności obsługowych i konserwacyjnych, jak i do usuwania awarii, usterek oraz wykonywania napraw eksploatowanych pojazdów. W związku z powyższym rzeczywiste ilości i rodzaj zamawianego asortymentu, częstotliwość składania zamówień oraz terminy realizacji poszczególnych zamówień wykonawczych mogą różnić się od ilości orientacyjnych wskazanych w załącznikach nr 1.1 – 1.3 do SWZ. Zamawiający będzie udzielał zamówień wykonawczych sukcesywnie, stosownie do rzeczywistych potrzeb wynikających z konieczności zapewnienia sprawności technicznej i ciągłości eksploatacji pojazdów, w granicach przedmiotu i maksymalnej wartości umowy ramowej. Zawarcie umowy ramowej nie oznacza zobowiązania Zamawiającego do zamówienia wszystkich pozycji asortymentowych ani wykorzystania pełnych ilości określonych w załącznikach nr 1.1 – 1.3. do SWZ. Wykonawca powinien uwzględnić szacunkowy charakter przedstawionych ilości przy kalkulacji oferty, z zastrzeżeniem zasad i warunków realizacji zamówień określonych w SWZ oraz umowie ramowej. Zamawiający zastrzega sobie prawo do zlecania dostaw asortymentu w ilościach mniejszych lub większych od ilości orientacyjnych wskazanych załącznikach.1.1 – 1.3. treści SWZ, z zastrzeżeniem, że łączna wartość wynagrodzenia Wykonawcy z tytułu realizacji umowy nie może przekroczyć wartości wynagrodzenia określonej w umowie. Zamawiający dopuszcza składanie ofert częściowych, z których każda będzie oceniana przez Zamawiającego oddzielnie, według zasad opisanych w SWZ. Zamówienie podzielone zostało na części, zgodnie z opisem zawartym w załącznikach nr 1.1. – 1.3. do SWZ. Każdy z Wykonawców może złożyć ofertę na dowolnie wybraną część/części. Zamawiający wymaga złożenia oferty na wszystkie wymagane pozycje wykazane w załącznikach nr 1.1. – 1.3. do SWZ. Ilekroć w niniejszej SWZ przedmiot zamówienia jest opisany ze wskazaniem znaków towarowych, patentów lub pochodzenia, źródła lub szczególnego procesu, który charakteryzuje produkty dostarczane przez konkretnego Wykonawcę, jeżeli mogłoby to doprowadzić do uprzywilejowania lub wyeliminowania niektórych wykonawców lub produktów, to przyjmuje się, że wskazaniom takim towarzyszą wyrazy „lub równoważne”. Zamawiający, opisując przedmiot zamówienia, na podstawie dyspozycji wyrażonej w art. 99 ustawy Pzp, wskazał na znak towarowy lub pochodzenie z uwagi na specyfikę przedmiotu zamówienia oraz brak możliwości jego opisania w sposób wyczerpujący za pomocą dokładnych i zrozumiałych określeń.

description: Furnizare REACTIVI ȘI CONSUMABILE PENTRU LABORATORUL DE ANALIZE MEDICALE II – CENTRUL DE IMUNOGENETICĂ ȘI VIRUSOLOGIE, necesare activității medicale curente a laboratorului (extracție ADN, tipizare HLA pentru transplant, monitorizare post-transplant, confirmare anti-HCV, genotipare pentru terapia imunosupresoare și determinări multiplex de biomarkeri), structurate în 6 (șase) loturi, în cadrul unui acord-cadru cu durata de 36 (treizeci și șase) de luni, atribuit unui singur operator economic pentru fiecare lot în parte, fără reluarea competiției la nivelul contractelor subsecvente. Pentru Loturile 1, 2, 3 și 5 se utilizează echipamentele existente în dotarea laboratorului (Lotul 4 nu necesită echipament); pentru Lotul 6, furnizorul pune la dispoziție gratuit, în comodat, pe durata acordului-cadru, analizorul compatibil cu reactivii ofertați.Fiecare lot face obiectul unui acord-cadru distinct; se pot depune oferte pentru unul, mai multe sau toate loturile. Punctajul se calculează separat pe fiecare lot, iar comparația se face exclusiv între ofertele admisibile depuse pe același lot. În conformitate cu prevederile art. 160 alin. (1) din Legea nr. 98/2016, termenul-limită până la care orice operator economic interesat de participarea la procedura de achiziție publică are dreptul de a solicita clarificări sau informații suplimentare în legătură cu documentația de atribuire este cu 21 de zile înainte de termenul-limită de depunere a ofertelor. În conformitate cu prevederile art. 160 alin. (2) din Legea nr. 98/2016, autoritatea contractantă stabilește un termen-limită în care va răspunde tuturor solicitărilor de clarificări/informațiilor suplimentare, în a 12-a zi înainte de data-limită de depunere a ofertelor.

title: erzo ARA, Klärschlammtrocknung Oftringen - Pumpen und Fördertechnik für entwässerten Klärschlamm
description:
Im Rahmen des Projekts „Ersatzbau Klärschlammverwertung“ wird die bisherige Klärschlammverbrennung auf dem Gelände der Kehrichtverwertungsanlage (KVA) durch eine neue

Trocknungsanlage ersetzt. Diese Anlage soll jährlich 34’000 t Klärschlamm von durchschnittlich 28.5% auf rund 90% Trockensubstanz (TS) trocknen. Der Klärschlamm besteht aus ARA eigenem und von anderen ARA aus der Schweiz angeliefertem Schlamm mit einer durchschnittlichen Dichte von

1.2 t/m3.


Die Anlage besteht aus mehreren Komponenten: einer Annahmehalle für den Schlamm, einem

Logistiksystem mit Bunker, Kran- und Förderanlagen, Trocknern mit Abluftreinigung und einer

Trockengutlagerung mit Verladestelle für den Abtransport. Der entwässerte Klärschlamm wird in der Annahmehalle per LKW angeliefert und in den Annahmebunker gekippt. Von dort wird er über eine Krananlage in den Stapelbunker oder direkt in die Schlammaufgabe befördert. Von der Schlammaufgabe wird der entwässerte Schlamm mit einem Pumpensystem in die Vorlage der Trocknung gepumpt. Die Trockner trocknen den Klärschlamm, die dabei entstehende Abluft wird über eine Abluftreinigung geführt. Der Getrocknete Klärschlamm (Trockengut genannt) wird über Hydraulische Fördersysteme in die Trockengutsilos befördert. Unter den Trockengutsilos liegt die Verladestelle für die Abholung des Trockenguts. Das Trockengut wird als Ersatzbrennstoff in der Zementindustrie verwendet.


Die Pumpen- und Fördertechnik besteht aus zwei voneinander unabhängigen Fördersträngen mit je

einem Schubboden zur Vermeidung und Auflösung von Brückenbildungen, hydraulische Vorstopfschnecke, einer hydraulischen ventillose Dickstoffkolbenpumpen, einem Hydrauliksystem zum Antrieb und einer Schmiermitteleindüsung für Brauchwasser. Jeder Förderstrang ist für eine

Austragsleistung von 12 m3/h ausgelegt; die Gesamtanlage ist nach dem Redundanzprinzip 2 × 100 %

auszuführen.


Auf dem Gelände der erzo ARA befinden sich bereits eine Abwasserreinigungsanlage (ARA) und eine

Kehrichtverwertungsanlage (KVA). Die KVA wird in naher Zukunft durch einen Neubau ersetzt. Die

daraus resultierenden Logistikströme müssen im Projekt berücksichtigt werden.

title: Tender BKP 358 Catering Kitchen
description:
Project Summary:


A new care center is to be constructed on plot no. 7297 for the company "Wohnen und Pflege Peteracker AG." The project comprises 56 care rooms and associated ancillary spaces, distributed across three floors. The ground floor will house a dedicated unit for residents with dementia, as well as a public restaurant and a dining hall for residents.


1. Background

In light of the constantly evolving and complex requirements for modern retirement and nursing homes—and for forward-looking elderly care—the Social Services Authority initiated the "Vision for Aging and Strategy for the Peteracker Retirement and Nursing Home (APH)" project in the autumn of 2017. The project focused on two main areas: inpatient care (at the Peteracker Retirement and Nursing Home, APH) and services for seniors who do not require inpatient care. The "Vision for Aging and Strategy for the Peteracker Retirement and Nursing Home (APH)" project was designed to be flexible enough to address both current and future requirements.

On February 13, 2022, the municipality’s electorate approved the separation of the Peteracker Retirement and Nursing Home (APH) from the political municipality of Rafz, transitioning it into a non-profit public limited company.

The Peteracker APH currently provides a living environment for 42 residents, offering high-quality, needs-based care and support, along with a range of other services. It is the only institution of its kind in the municipality of Rafz. "Wohnen und Pflege Peteracker AG" operates the retirement and nursing home and has acquired the land from the municipality under a long-term leasehold agreement (building rights). The Peteracker site, home to the Peteracker retirement and nursing home (APH), is located just outside the village center of Rafz, situated between the main road and the SBB railway line. Directly opposite the Peteracker facility lies the former brickworks of the Zürcher Ziegeleien (Zurich Brickworks). The area is defined by a distinct rural charm.


2. Urban Design

The new building integrates into the existing Peteracker complex as part of a hamlet-like ensemble. Its positioning takes its cue from the loose arrangement of the existing structures, strengthening their spatial cohesion. The substantial building mass is articulated through a longitudinal main structure and two flanking wings; this gives the impression of a composition of smaller building volumes, remaining in keeping with the local scale. At the center, a new, courtyard-like village square emerges, serving as a communal space that fosters a sense of identity. Visual connections to the open landscape and the existing buildings are preserved.


3. Functional Distribution

The ground floor serves as the public hub of the facility, housing the entrance, reception, restaurant, and dining hall. These spaces are designed for flexible use and can be combined to accommodate events. The administrative offices are directly connected to the entrance area, while the kitchen, delivery, and logistics zones are functionally organized with separate access. The upper floors contain four residential units, comprising a total of 44 single rooms. Each unit is clearly laid out and accessible via a circular circulation path. A specialized residential unit for 13 residents with dementia is located in a protected setting on the raised ground floor, with direct access to a private garden. The basement level houses the laundry facility, as well as storage and technical areas. It also contains an underground parking garage with 24 spaces for the care center’s staff.


4. Landscape Design

The landscape at the edge of the settlement in the Rafzerfeld region combines a high quality of rural life with an environment shaped by a cultivated landscape. The open-space concept draws upon the loosely arranged structure typical of the local area, developing the site into a hamlet-like complex centered around a village square. Green spaces and plantings structure the outdoor area, minimize sealed surfaces, and integrate the site into the surrounding landscape. A sophisticated network of paths, combined with a clear separation between vehicular and pedestrian traffic, ensures excellent accessibility and a high-quality environment for spending time outdoors. Furthermore, specific features—such as a south-facing sun terrace, a sheltered garden for residents with dementia, and a diverse range of plantings—create attractive spaces that enhance the well-being of the residents.


5. Construction

The building’s structural framework is composed of reinforced concrete and masonry. Seismic safety is ensured through continuous circulation cores spanning all floors, strategically placed concrete shear walls within the exterior envelope, and reinforced concrete floor slabs. The building’s exterior walls consist of non-load-bearing, insulated timber elements that span multiple floors. On the interior, these elements are fitted with a service layer for building installations, while the exterior is clad in a ventilated timber façade.
